paragraphs: My grandpa has a fun week. He likes fishing. On Monday, he goes fishing at six o'clock. He sits next to the water. He catches a big fish. He is very happy. On Tuesday, he listens to the radio. He enjoys the songs. On Wednesday, he looks at photos. He has a photo of Dad. He smiles.

On Thursday, he plays table tennis with Sam. Sam is eight. Grandpa is very good. On Friday, he goes fishing again. He catches two fish. This is his favorite day. He sits under a tree. On Saturday, our family eats dinner at his house. We eat in the kitchen. He has rice and fish for us. We enjoy the dinner.
On Sunday, he plays with Pip in the park. Pip is a funny dog. Pip says, "Woof!" It is a nice week. What is your favorite day? Can you say the days of the week?
text.summary: Tom tells us about his grandpa's week. On each day Grandpa does one thing, such as fishing, table tennis, or a family dinner.
